Code walkthrough - load content and event handling

features.name: Flexible height control for control add-ins
features.description: Allows developers to adjust control add-in height dynamically with options including fill parent, fixed height, margins, and offsets. Solves the problem of Microsoft's inconsistent height handling.
caveats: Height control varies inconsistently across Microsoft's default implementation

features.name: Keyboard input routing in control add-ins
features.description: Routes keyboard presses through the control add-in so Business Central standard keys remain functional when focus is on the control. Addresses accessibility issues for users with alternative input methods.
caveats: Standard Business Central controls capture keyboard input by default

features.name: Caption translation support in control add-ins
features.description: Passes labels from AL code into control add-ins to support dynamic caption translation. Enables control add-in text to change when application language changes.
caveats: Labels must be explicitly defined in AL

features.name: Resource streaming for control add-in content
features.description: Streams resources (HTML, SVG, icons, text) from the app into the control add-in for rendering instead of embedding as strings in code. Makes content management easier.

features.name: Starter kit with skill document for new control add-ins
features.description: Open source repository with scaffolding template and documentation to quickly create new control add-ins. Can be used as template in development tools like Codex.
caveats: Still evolving, may not be worlds best yet

features.name: User control host page type limitation - no page close event
features.description: User control host page type currently lacks a page close event, making it risky for pages with editable data as users can close without saving. Only reliable for read-only scenarios.
caveats: Data loss risk for editable content
Built primarily for Power BI scenarios
Microsoft has been notified of limitation

features.name: Control ready event for initialization timing
features.description: User control add-ins fire an on control ready event when initialized, which is later than page open. Developers cannot assume the control is ready on page open.
caveats: Event fires after page open, not during
